source.text: וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And the tabernacle you will make [of] ten curtains [of] fine twisted linen and blue and purple and scarlet [yarn]; [with] cherubim, the work of a skillful worker, you will make them.

en.L: And the tabernacle you shall make [of] ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue and purple and scarlet [yarn]; [with] cherubim, the work of a skilled craftsman, you shall make them.
en.B: For the tabernacle you are to make ten curtains of fine twisted linen and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn. Have cherubim worked into them, the design of a skilled craftsman.
en.R: Make the tabernacle, the sacred tent, out of ten curtains. Make them from fine twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn. Have a skilled craftsman work cherubim into the cloth.

es.L: Y el tabernáculo lo harás [de] diez cortinas de lino fino torcido, y [hilo] azul, y púrpura, y escarlata; [con] querubines, obra de un artesano hábil, las harás.
es.B: Para el tabernáculo harás diez cortinas de lino fino torcido y de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata. Llevarán querubines tejidos, obra de un artesano hábil.
es.R: Haz el tabernáculo, la tienda sagrada, con diez cortinas. Hazlas de lino fino torcido y de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata. Pide a un artesano hábil que teja querubines en la tela.

fr.L: Et la Demeure, tu [la] feras [de] dix tentures de fin lin retors, et [de fil] bleu, et pourpre, et écarlate ; [avec] des chérubins, travail d’un artisan habile, tu les feras.
fr.B: Pour la Demeure, tu feras dix tentures de fin lin retors et de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate. Des chérubins y seront tissés, œuvre d’un artisan habile.
fr.R: Fais le tabernacle, la tente sacrée, avec dix tentures. Fais-les en fin lin retors et en fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate. Demande à un artisan habile de tisser des chérubins dans le tissu.

sw.L: Nawe maskani utaifanya [kwa] mapazia kumi ya kitani safi iliyosokotwa, na [uzi wa] samawati, na zambarau, na rangi nyekundu; [pamoja na] makerubi, kazi ya fundi stadi, utayafanya.
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya maskani ufanye mapazia kumi ya kitani safi iliyosokotwa, na ya uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu. Makerubi yafumwe ndani yake, kazi ya fundi stadi.
sw.R: Tengeneza maskani, yaani hema takatifu, kwa mapazia kumi. Yatengeneze kwa kitani safi iliyosokotwa na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu. Mwambie fundi stadi afume makerubi kwenye kitambaa.

decisions.choice: tabernacle: the dwelling, the tent where God would live among his people
decisions.reason: The word means a dwelling place. God said, "Let them make me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them" (25:8), and this word comes from the same root as "dwell". In this chapter it names first the inner layer of linen curtains (verses 1-6) and then the whole structure (verses 15-30).

decisions.choice: fine twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn: the costliest cloth and dyes
decisions.reason: Linen of fine thread, spun from several strands twisted together, was the best cloth of Egypt. Blue and purple dyes, made from sea snails, and scarlet, made from an insect, were rare and costly. The same materials are listed among the gifts in 25:4.

decisions.choice: the work of a skillful worker: woven in a design by a master craftsman
decisions.reason: The worker named here is one who designs and devises (31:4; 35:35). His work is set apart from that of the embroiderer, who makes the screen at the entrance (verse 36). Here the cherubim are woven into the cloth itself.

decisions.choice: the sacred tent
decisions.reason: Readable adds "the sacred tent" to explain "tabernacle", a word many readers do not use.

decisions.choice: "cortinas" (yeri'ot); "lino fino torcido"
decisions.reason: The tabernacle's woven panels are "cortinas" throughout Exodus 26 and 35-40, kept apart from the veil ("velo" at L), the entrance screen ("cortina para la entrada") and the courtyard hangings ("colgaduras"). "Torcido" is thread spun from twisted strands.

decisions.choice: "tentures" (yeri'ot); "fin lin retors"
decisions.reason: The large woven panels that make up the Demeure are "tentures" throughout Exodus 26 and 35-40, kept apart from the veil ("voile" at L), the inner curtain ("rideau intérieur" at B, R), the entrance screen ("rideau") and the courtyard hangings ("toiles"). "Retors" is the usual word for thread twisted from several strands.

decisions.choice: "mapazia" (yeri'ot); "fundi stadi"
decisions.reason: The tabernacle's woven panels are "mapazia" (sg. "pazia") throughout Exodus 26 and 35-40; the veil is "pazia" (L) or "pazia la ndani" (B, R) and the entrance screen "pazia la mlango". The craftsman who weaves designs is "fundi stadi"; the embroiderer of verse 36 is "mtarizi".

source.text: אֹ֣רֶךְ׀הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל־הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: The length of the one curtain [will be] eight and twenty by the cubit, and the width four by the cubit, the one curtain; one measure for all the curtains.

en.L: The length of the one curtain [shall be] 28 cubits, and the width of the one curtain 4 cubits; one measure for all the curtains.
en.B: Each curtain is to be {{units:about 42 feet|28 cubits}} long and {{units:about 6 feet|4 cubits}} wide; all the curtains are to have one measure.
en.R: Each curtain must be {{units:about 42 feet|28 cubits}} long and {{units:about 6 feet|4 cubits}} wide. Make them all the same size.

es.L: La longitud de una cortina [será] veintiocho codos, y la anchura de una cortina cuatro codos; una misma medida para todas las cortinas.
es.B: Cada cortina tendrá {{units:unos 12,60 metros|veintiocho codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 1,80 metros|cuatro codos}} de ancho; todas las cortinas tendrán la misma medida.
es.R: Cada cortina debe medir {{units:unos 12,60 metros|veintiocho codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 1,80 metros|cuatro codos}} de ancho. Hazlas todas del mismo tamaño.

fr.L: La longueur d’une tenture [sera de] vingt-huit coudées, et la largeur d’une tenture, quatre coudées ; une même mesure pour toutes les tentures.
fr.B: Chaque tenture aura {{units:environ 12,60 mètres|vingt-huit coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 1,80 mètre|quatre coudées}} de large ; toutes les tentures auront la même mesure.
fr.R: Chaque tenture doit mesurer {{units:environ 12,60 mètres|vingt-huit coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 1,80 mètre|quatre coudées}} de large. Elles doivent toutes avoir la même taille.

sw.L: Urefu wa pazia moja [utakuwa] dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa pazia moja dhiraa nne; kipimo kimoja kwa mapazia yote.
sw.B: Kila pazia liwe na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 12.6|dhiraa ishirini na nane}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 1.8|dhiraa nne}}; mapazia yote yawe na kipimo kimoja.
sw.R: Kila pazia lazima liwe na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 12.6|dhiraa ishirini na nane}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 1.8|dhiraa nne}}. Yafanye yote yawe na ukubwa uleule.

decisions.choice: cubit: the length from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger, about 18 inches
decisions.reason: The cubit was the common measure of length. It was about 18 inches (about 45 centimeters); a longer royal cubit was also known (Ezekiel 40:5). So each linen curtain was about 42 feet long and 6 feet wide.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 42 feet|28 cubits}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the measure in feet and inches, taking a cubit as about 18 inches; the setting shows the cubits of the Hebrew. Literal keeps the cubits.

source.text: חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶ֨יןָ֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָ֑הּ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Five of the curtains will be joined, a woman to her sister, and five curtains joined, a woman to her sister.

en.L: Five of the curtains shall be joined one to another, and five curtains joined one to another.
en.B: Five of the curtains are to be joined to one another, and the other five joined to one another as well.
en.R: Join five of the curtains together into one set. Do the same with the other five.

es.L: Cinco de las cortinas estarán unidas una con otra, y cinco cortinas unidas una con otra.
es.B: Cinco de las cortinas irán unidas entre sí, y las otras cinco también irán unidas entre sí.
es.R: Une cinco de las cortinas para formar un solo conjunto. Haz lo mismo con las otras cinco.

fr.L: Cinq des tentures seront jointes l’une à l’autre, et cinq tentures jointes l’une à l’autre.
fr.B: Cinq des tentures seront assemblées l’une à l’autre, et les cinq autres le seront aussi entre elles.
fr.R: Assemble cinq des tentures pour en faire un seul ensemble. Fais de même avec les cinq autres.

sw.L: Mapazia matano yataungwa kila moja na jingine, na mapazia matano yataungwa kila moja na jingine.
sw.B: Mapazia matano yaungwe pamoja, na matano mengine nayo yaungwe pamoja vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Unganisha mapazia matano yawe fungu moja. Fanya vivyo hivyo kwa yale matano mengine.

decisions.choice: a woman to her sister: one to another
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a woman to her sister", a way of saying "each to the other" when the nouns are feminine, as "curtain" is. The same phrase returns in verses 5, 6 and 17. The ten curtains form two sets of five.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וְכֵ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain at the end in the set; and so you will do on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.

en.L: And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain, at the end in the set; and so you shall do on the edge of the outermost curtain in the second set.
en.B: Put loops of blue yarn on the outer edge of the last curtain in the first set. Put them likewise on the edge of the outermost curtain of the second set.
en.R: Make loops of blue yarn along the edge of the last curtain in each set.

es.L: Y harás presillas de [hilo] azul en el borde de una cortina, en el extremo del conjunto; y lo mismo harás en el borde de la cortina más exterior del segundo conjunto.
es.B: Pondrás presillas de hilo azul en el borde exterior de la última cortina del primer conjunto, y lo mismo en el borde de la cortina del extremo del segundo conjunto.
es.R: Haz presillas de hilo azul a lo largo del borde de la última cortina de cada conjunto.

fr.L: Et tu feras des boucles de [fil] bleu sur le bord d’une tenture, à l’extrémité de l’assemblage ; et tu feras de même sur le bord de la tenture la plus extérieure du second assemblage.
fr.B: Tu mettras des boucles de fil bleu sur le bord extérieur de la dernière tenture du premier assemblage, et tu feras de même sur le bord de la tenture extrême du second assemblage.
fr.R: Fais des boucles de fil bleu le long du bord de la dernière tenture de chaque ensemble.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya vitanzi vya [uzi wa] samawati kwenye pindo la pazia moja, mwishoni mwa fungu; na ndivyo utakavyofanya kwenye pindo la pazia la mwisho kabisa katika fungu la pili.
sw.B: Utie vitanzi vya uzi wa samawati kwenye pindo la nje la pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, na vivyo hivyo kwenye pindo la pazia la mwisho la fungu la pili.
sw.R: Tengeneza vitanzi vya uzi wa samawati kwenye pindo la pazia la mwisho la kila fungu.

decisions.choice: the set: the group of five joined curtains
decisions.reason: The word means a joining, here the joined group of five curtains (verse 3). The loops go on the edge of the end curtain of each set, where the two sets meet.

decisions.choice: in each set
decisions.reason: Readable says the two halves of the verse once, since the same thing is done to both sets.

decisions.choice: "presillas" (loops); "conjunto" (the set)
decisions.reason: "Presillas" are small loops for fastening, which is what these are; "lazos" would suggest ribbons or bows. The set of five joined curtains is "conjunto" at every level.

decisions.choice: "boucles" (loops); "assemblage" (L, B), "ensemble" (R) (the set)
decisions.reason: "Boucles" is the plain word for loops of thread; "lacets" now means shoelaces. The joined set of five curtains is an "assemblage"; Readable says "ensemble".

decisions.choice: "vitanzi" (loops); "pindo" (edge); "fungu" (the set)
decisions.reason: "Kitanzi" is a loop of thread. The edge of the cloth is its "pindo", leaving "ukingo" for the gold molding of 25:11. The set of five joined curtains is a "fungu".

source.text: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Fifty loops you will make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you will make on the end of the curtain which [is] in the second set, the loops opposite, a woman to her sister.

en.L: Fifty loops you shall make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you shall make on the end of the curtain that [is] in the second set, the loops [being] opposite one another.
en.B: Put fifty loops on the one curtain and fifty on the end of the curtain in the second set, so that the loops line up with each other.
en.R: There should be fifty loops on each of these two curtains, and the loops should line up across from each other.

es.L: Cincuenta presillas harás en una cortina, y cincuenta presillas harás en el extremo de la cortina que [está] en el segundo conjunto, las presillas [quedarán] una frente a otra.
es.B: Pondrás cincuenta presillas en una cortina y cincuenta en el extremo de la cortina del segundo conjunto, de modo que las presillas queden unas frente a otras.
es.R: Cada una de estas dos cortinas debe tener cincuenta presillas, y las presillas deben quedar una enfrente de la otra.

fr.L: Tu feras cinquante boucles à une tenture, et tu feras cinquante boucles à l’extrémité de la tenture qui [est] dans le second assemblage, les boucles [étant] en face l’une de l’autre.
fr.B: Tu mettras cinquante boucles à l’une des tentures et cinquante à l’extrémité de la tenture du second assemblage, de sorte que les boucles se correspondent.
fr.R: Ces deux tentures doivent avoir chacune cinquante boucles, placées bien en face les unes des autres.

sw.L: Vitanzi hamsini utavifanya kwenye pazia moja, na vitanzi hamsini utavifanya kwenye mwisho wa pazia lililo katika fungu la pili, vitanzi [vikiwa] vimekabiliana kimoja na kingine.
sw.B: Utie vitanzi hamsini kwenye pazia moja na hamsini kwenye mwisho wa pazia la fungu la pili, ili vitanzi vikabiliane.
sw.R: Kila moja ya mapazia hayo mawili lazima liwe na vitanzi hamsini, navyo vikabiliane ana kwa ana.

decisions.choice: opposite: facing each other in matching pairs
decisions.reason: The loops on the two edges face each other, so that each pair can be fastened with one clasp (verse 6).

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וְחִבַּרְתָּ֨אֶת־הַיְרִיעֹ֜ת אִשָּׁ֤ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָהּ֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you will make fifty clasps of gold and join the curtains, a woman to her sister, with the clasps, and the tabernacle will be one.

en.L: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold and join the curtains one to another with the clasps, and the tabernacle shall be one.
en.B: Make fifty clasps of gold and join the two sets of curtains with them, one to the other. Then the tabernacle will be one whole.
en.R: Make fifty gold clasps. Hook the two sets of curtains together with them. Then the tabernacle will be all one piece.

es.L: Y harás cincuenta broches de oro, y unirás las cortinas una con otra con los broches, y el tabernáculo será uno.
es.B: Harás cincuenta broches de oro y con ellos unirás los dos conjuntos de cortinas, el uno con el otro. Así el tabernáculo formará un solo todo.
es.R: Haz cincuenta broches de oro. Engancha con ellos los dos conjuntos de cortinas. Así el tabernáculo quedará de una sola pieza.

fr.L: Et tu feras cinquante agrafes d’or, et tu joindras les tentures l’une à l’autre avec les agrafes, et la Demeure sera une.
fr.B: Tu feras cinquante agrafes d’or et tu joindras avec elles les deux assemblages de tentures, l’un à l’autre. Ainsi la Demeure formera un tout.
fr.R: Fais cinquante agrafes en or. Accroche avec elles les deux ensembles de tentures l’un à l’autre. Ainsi, le tabernacle sera d’une seule pièce.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu, na kuyaunganisha mapazia kila moja na jingine kwa vifungo hivyo, nayo maskani itakuwa moja.
sw.B: Ufanye vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu, na kwavyo uunganishe mafungu mawili ya mapazia, moja na jingine. Hivyo maskani itakuwa kitu kimoja kizima.
sw.R: Tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu. Vitumie kuyafungamanisha mafungu mawili ya mapazia. Hivyo maskani itakuwa kipande kimoja.

decisions.choice: clasps: fasteners that hook through the loops
decisions.reason: The word is used only of the tabernacle (here, verses 11 and 33; 35:11; 39:33). Each clasp passes through a pair of loops and holds the two sets of curtains together.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle will be one: a single dwelling
decisions.reason: The ten curtains are to become one tabernacle, one dwelling for God among his people. The same words are said of the tent in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "broches" (clasps)
decisions.reason: A "broche" is a fastener that hooks two pieces together; "ganchos" is kept for the hooks on the pillars (verse 32).

decisions.choice: "agrafes" (clasps)
decisions.reason: "Agrafes" fasten two edges together through the loops; "crochets" is kept for the hooks on the pillars (verse 32).

decisions.choice: "vifungo" (clasps)
decisions.reason: "Kifungo" is a fastener; "kulabu" is kept for the hooks on the pillars (verse 32).

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּי־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make curtains of goats' [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains you will make them.

en.L: And you shall make curtains of goats' [hair] for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains you shall make.
en.B: Then make eleven curtains of goats' hair to be a tent over the tabernacle.
en.R: Make eleven curtains of goats' hair. They will form a tent that covers the tabernacle.

es.L: Y harás cortinas de [pelo de] cabras para una tienda sobre el tabernáculo; once cortinas harás.
es.B: Harás también once cortinas de pelo de cabra que sirvan de tienda sobre el tabernáculo.
es.R: Haz once cortinas de pelo de cabra. Formarán una tienda que cubrirá el tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et tu feras des tentures de [poil de] chèvres pour une tente au-dessus de la Demeure ; tu feras onze tentures.
fr.B: Tu feras ensuite onze tentures en poil de chèvre pour former une tente au-dessus de la Demeure.
fr.R: Fais onze tentures en poil de chèvre. Elles formeront une tente qui couvrira le tabernacle.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya mapazia ya [manyoya ya] mbuzi kwa ajili ya hema juu ya maskani; mapazia kumi na moja utayafanya.
sw.B: Kisha ufanye mapazia kumi na moja ya manyoya ya mbuzi, yawe hema juu ya maskani.
sw.R: Tengeneza mapazia kumi na moja ya manyoya ya mbuzi. Yatakuwa hema linalofunika maskani.

decisions.choice: goats' hair: coarse dark cloth, used for tents
decisions.reason: Cloth woven from the hair of black goats was tough and kept out the rain. It was the usual cloth for tents (compare Song of Songs 1:5). It was among the gifts asked for in 25:4.

decisions.choice: a tent over the tabernacle: a second layer spread above the linen
decisions.reason: Here "the tabernacle" is the layer of linen curtains (verses 1-6), and "the tent" is the layer of goats'-hair curtains spread over it.

source.text: אֹ֣רֶךְ׀הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: The length of the one curtain [will be] thirty by the cubit, and the width four by the cubit, the one curtain; one measure for the eleven curtains.

en.L: The length of the one curtain [shall be] 30 cubits, and the width of the one curtain 4 cubits; one measure for the eleven curtains.
en.B: Each curtain is to be {{units:about 45 feet|30 cubits}} long and {{units:about 6 feet|4 cubits}} wide; all eleven are to have one measure.
en.R: Each of these curtains must be {{units:about 45 feet|30 cubits}} long and {{units:about 6 feet|4 cubits}} wide. All eleven must be the same size.

es.L: La longitud de una cortina [será] treinta codos, y la anchura de una cortina cuatro codos; una misma medida para las once cortinas.
es.B: Cada cortina tendrá {{units:unos 13,50 metros|treinta codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 1,80 metros|cuatro codos}} de ancho; las once tendrán la misma medida.
es.R: Cada una de estas cortinas debe medir {{units:unos 13,50 metros|treinta codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 1,80 metros|cuatro codos}} de ancho. Las once deben ser del mismo tamaño.

fr.L: La longueur d’une tenture [sera de] trente coudées, et la largeur d’une tenture, quatre coudées ; une même mesure pour les onze tentures.
fr.B: Chaque tenture aura {{units:environ 13,50 mètres|trente coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 1,80 mètre|quatre coudées}} de large ; les onze auront la même mesure.
fr.R: Chacune de ces tentures doit mesurer {{units:environ 13,50 mètres|trente coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 1,80 mètre|quatre coudées}} de large. Les onze doivent avoir la même taille.

sw.L: Urefu wa pazia moja [utakuwa] dhiraa thelathini, na upana wa pazia moja dhiraa nne; kipimo kimoja kwa mapazia kumi na moja.
sw.B: Kila pazia liwe na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 13.5|dhiraa thelathini}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 1.8|dhiraa nne}}; yote kumi na moja yawe na kipimo kimoja.
sw.R: Kila moja ya mapazia haya lazima liwe na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 13.5|dhiraa thelathini}} na upana wa {{units:karibu mita 1.8|dhiraa nne}}. Yote kumi na moja yawe na ukubwa uleule.

decisions.choice: thirty cubits: two cubits longer than the linen curtains
decisions.reason: The goats'-hair curtains are longer than the linen ones (28 cubits, verse 2), and there is one more of them, so the outer tent covers the inner one fully (verses 12-13).

decisions.choice: {{units:about 45 feet|30 cubits}}
decisions.reason: Measures as in verse 2, with a cubit as about 18 inches.

source.text: וְחִבַּרְתָּ֞ אֶת־חֲמֵ֤שׁ הַיְרִיעֹת֙ לְבָ֔ד וְאֶת־שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְכָפַלְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔ית אֶל־מ֖וּל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will join five of the curtains by themselves and six of the curtains by themselves, and you will fold double the sixth curtain toward the front of the face of the tent.

en.L: And you shall join five of the curtains by themselves and six of the curtains by themselves, and you shall fold double the sixth curtain at the front of the tent.
en.B: Join five curtains together by themselves, and six by themselves. The sixth curtain is to be folded over double across the front of the tent.
en.R: Join five of them together, and join the other six together. Fold the extra sixth curtain in half and let it hang at the front of the tent.

es.L: Y unirás cinco de las cortinas aparte, y seis de las cortinas aparte, y doblarás la sexta cortina en la parte delantera de la tienda.
es.B: Unirás cinco cortinas por un lado y seis por otro. La sexta cortina se doblará sobre la parte delantera de la tienda.
es.R: Une cinco de estas cortinas, y luego une las otras seis. La sexta sobra: dóblala por la mitad y déjala colgar en la parte delantera de la tienda.

fr.L: Et tu joindras cinq des tentures à part, et six des tentures à part, et tu replieras en double la sixième tenture sur le devant de la tente.
fr.B: Tu assembleras cinq tentures d’un côté et six de l’autre. La sixième tenture sera repliée en double sur le devant de la tente.
fr.R: Assemble cinq de ces tentures, puis assemble les six autres. La sixième est en trop : plie-la en deux et laisse-la pendre sur le devant de la tente.

sw.L: Nawe utaunganisha mapazia matano peke yake, na mapazia sita peke yake, nawe utalikunja mara mbili pazia la sita mbele ya hema.
sw.B: Uunganishe mapazia matano peke yake, na sita peke yake. Pazia la sita likunjwe mara mbili upande wa mbele wa hema.
sw.R: Unganisha mapazia matano pamoja, kisha unganisha yale sita mengine. Pazia la sita ni la ziada: likunje katikati na uliache lining'inie mbele ya hema.

decisions.choice: fold double the sixth curtain: the extra curtain is doubled over at the entrance
decisions.reason: With six curtains in one set, the goats'-hair tent is one curtain wider than the linen beneath it. Half of the extra width is folded over at the front; the other half hangs at the back (verse 12). Just how the fold lay is not described.

decisions.choice: the extra sixth curtain ... in half ... let it hang
decisions.reason: Readable explains that the sixth curtain is the one more than the linen set has, and what folding it double means.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain, the outermost in the set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain [of] the second set.

en.L: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain, the outermost in the set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain [of] the second set.
en.B: On the outer edge of the last curtain in the first set put fifty loops, and fifty more on the edge of the joining curtain in the second set.
en.R: Put fifty loops along the edge of the last curtain in each set.

es.L: Y harás cincuenta presillas en el borde de una cortina, la más exterior del conjunto, y cincuenta presillas en el borde de la cortina [del] segundo conjunto.
es.B: Pondrás cincuenta presillas en el borde exterior de la última cortina del primer conjunto, y otras cincuenta en el borde de la cortina de unión del segundo conjunto.
es.R: Pon cincuenta presillas a lo largo del borde de la última cortina de cada conjunto.

fr.L: Et tu feras cinquante boucles sur le bord d’une tenture, la plus extérieure de l’assemblage, et cinquante boucles sur le bord de la tenture [du] second assemblage.
fr.B: Tu mettras cinquante boucles sur le bord extérieur de la dernière tenture du premier assemblage, et cinquante autres sur le bord de la tenture qui rejoint le second assemblage.
fr.R: Mets cinquante boucles le long du bord de la dernière tenture de chaque ensemble.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya vitanzi hamsini kwenye pindo la pazia moja, lile la mwisho katika fungu, na vitanzi hamsini kwenye pindo la pazia [la] fungu la pili.
sw.B: Utie vitanzi hamsini kwenye pindo la nje la pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, na vingine hamsini kwenye pindo la pazia linalounganisha fungu la pili.
sw.R: Tia vitanzi hamsini kwenye pindo la pazia la mwisho la kila fungu.

decisions.choice: fifty loops: the goats'-hair sets are joined as the linen sets were
decisions.reason: The outer tent is joined in the same way as the inner tabernacle (verses 4-5): fifty loops on each edge where the two sets meet.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־הַקְּרָסִים֙ בַּלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת וְחִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל וְהָיָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make clasps of bronze, fifty, and you will put the clasps in the loops and join together the tent, and it will be one.

en.L: And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and you shall put the clasps into the loops and join the tent together, and it shall be one.
en.B: Make fifty clasps of bronze. Fit the clasps into the loops and join the tent together, so that it becomes one whole.
en.R: Make fifty bronze clasps and hook them through the loops. This will join the tent into one piece.

es.L: Y harás cincuenta broches de bronce, y meterás los broches en las presillas, y unirás la tienda, y será una.
es.B: Harás cincuenta broches de bronce, los meterás en las presillas y unirás la tienda, para que forme un solo todo.
es.R: Haz cincuenta broches de bronce y engánchalos en las presillas. Así la tienda quedará de una sola pieza.

fr.L: Et tu feras cinquante agrafes de bronze, et tu introduiras les agrafes dans les boucles, et tu joindras la tente, et elle sera une.
fr.B: Tu feras cinquante agrafes de bronze, tu les passeras dans les boucles et tu assembleras la tente, pour qu’elle forme un tout.
fr.R: Fais cinquante agrafes en bronze et accroche-les dans les boucles. La tente sera ainsi d’une seule pièce.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya vifungo hamsini vya shaba, nawe utavitia vifungo katika vitanzi, na kuliunganisha hema, nalo litakuwa moja.
sw.B: Ufanye vifungo hamsini vya shaba, uvitie katika vitanzi na kuliunganisha hema, ili liwe kitu kimoja kizima.
sw.R: Tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya shaba na uvipitishe katika vitanzi. Hivyo hema litakuwa kipande kimoja.

decisions.choice: bronze: a less costly metal for the outer layer
decisions.reason: The clasps of the inner linen layer are gold (verse 6); those of the outer goats'-hair tent are bronze. Throughout the tabernacle the metals are more precious the nearer they are to the most holy place (compare verses 32 and 37).

source.text: וְסֶ֨רַח֙ הָעֹדֵ֔ף בִּירִיעֹ֖ת הָאֹ֑הֶל חֲצִ֤י הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָעֹדֶ֔פֶת תִּסְרַ֕ח עַ֖ל אֲחֹרֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And the overhang of the surplus in the curtains of the tent, the half of the curtain that is surplus, will hang over the rear of the tabernacle.

en.L: And the overhanging part that is left over in the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that is left over, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
en.B: Half of a curtain will be left over from the curtains of the tent. Let that surplus hang down over the rear of the tabernacle.
en.R: The goats'-hair curtains cover more than the linen ones. Let the extra half curtain hang down over the back of the tabernacle.

es.L: Y la parte que cuelga, lo que sobra en las cortinas de la tienda, la media cortina que sobra, colgará sobre la parte trasera del tabernáculo.
es.B: De las cortinas de la tienda sobrará media cortina. Ese sobrante colgará sobre la parte trasera del tabernáculo.
es.R: Las cortinas de pelo de cabra cubren más que las de lino. Deja que la media cortina que sobra cuelgue sobre la parte de atrás del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et la partie qui pend, ce qui reste en surplus dans les tentures de la tente, la demi-tenture en surplus, pendra sur l’arrière de la Demeure.
fr.B: Il restera une demi-tenture de surplus dans les tentures de la tente. Ce surplus retombera sur l’arrière de la Demeure.
fr.R: Les tentures en poil de chèvre couvrent plus que celles en lin. Laisse la demi-tenture en trop retomber sur l’arrière du tabernacle.

sw.L: Na sehemu inayoning'inia, iliyozidi katika mapazia ya hema, nusu ya pazia iliyozidi, itaning'inia juu ya upande wa nyuma wa maskani.
sw.B: Nusu ya pazia itabaki ikiwa ya ziada katika mapazia ya hema. Ziada hiyo ining'inie juu ya upande wa nyuma wa maskani.
sw.R: Mapazia ya manyoya ya mbuzi yanafunika zaidi kuliko yale ya kitani. Acha nusu ya pazia iliyozidi ining'inie upande wa nyuma wa maskani.

decisions.choice: the half curtain left over: the surplus width at the back
decisions.reason: Eleven goats'-hair curtains, 4 cubits wide, are 44 cubits across; the ten linen curtains are 40. One extra curtain was folded double at the front (verse 9), so half a curtain remains to hang at the rear. The verse does not say exactly how it was arranged.

decisions.choice: The goats'-hair curtains cover more than the linen ones.
decisions.reason: Readable adds a sentence to explain why there is a half curtain left over.

source.text: וְהָאַמָּ֨ה מִזֶּ֜ה וְהָאַמָּ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ בָּעֹדֵ֔ף בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ יְרִיעֹ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל יִהְיֶ֨ה סָר֜וּחַ עַל־צִדֵּ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה לְכַסֹּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the cubit from this [side] and the cubit from this [side], in the surplus in the length of the curtains of the tent, will be overhanging over the sides of the tabernacle from this and from this, to cover it.

en.L: And the cubit on this [side] and the cubit on that [side], of what is left over in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle, on this [side] and on that [side], to cover it.
en.B: In length the tent curtains will be longer by {{units:about 18 inches|a cubit}} at each end. Let this surplus hang down over both sides of the tabernacle and cover it.
en.R: The goats'-hair curtains are also longer. Let {{units:about 18 inches|a cubit}} of extra cloth hang down on each side of the tabernacle to cover it.

es.L: Y el codo de este [lado] y el codo de aquel [lado], de lo que sobra en la longitud de las cortinas de la tienda, colgará sobre los costados del tabernáculo, de este [lado] y de aquel, para cubrirlo.
es.B: A lo largo, las cortinas de la tienda sobrarán {{units:unos 45 centímetros|un codo}} en cada extremo. Ese sobrante colgará sobre los dos costados del tabernáculo para cubrirlo.
es.R: Las cortinas de pelo de cabra también son más largas. Deja que {{units:unos 45 centímetros|un codo}} de tela sobrante cuelgue a cada lado del tabernáculo para cubrirlo.

fr.L: Et la coudée d’un [côté] et la coudée de l’autre, de ce qui reste en surplus dans la longueur des tentures de la tente, pendront sur les côtés de la Demeure, d’un [côté] et de l’autre, pour la couvrir.
fr.B: Dans le sens de la longueur, les tentures de la tente dépasseront de {{units:environ 45 centimètres|une coudée}} à chaque extrémité. Ce surplus retombera sur les deux côtés de la Demeure pour la couvrir.
fr.R: Les tentures en poil de chèvre sont aussi plus longues. Laisse {{units:environ 45 centimètres|une coudée}} de tissu en trop pendre de chaque côté du tabernacle pour le couvrir.

sw.L: Na dhiraa upande huu na dhiraa upande ule, ya kile kilichozidi katika urefu wa mapazia ya hema, itaning'inia juu ya pande za maskani, upande huu na upande ule, ili kuifunika.
sw.B: Kwa urefu, mapazia ya hema yatazidi kwa {{units:karibu sentimita 45|dhiraa moja}} kila upande. Ziada hiyo ining'inie juu ya pande zote mbili za maskani ili kuifunika.
sw.R: Mapazia ya manyoya ya mbuzi pia ni marefu zaidi. Acha {{units:karibu sentimita 45|dhiraa moja}} ya kitambaa kilichozidi ining'inie kila upande wa maskani ili kuifunika.

decisions.choice: the cubit on this side and the cubit on that side: one cubit extra at each side
decisions.reason: The goats'-hair curtains are 30 cubits long (verse 8) and the linen ones 28 (verse 2). The extra two cubits give one cubit more on each side, so the outer tent hangs lower than the linen and covers it.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 18 inches|a cubit}}
decisions.reason: Measures as in verse 2, with a cubit as about 18 inches.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you will make a covering for the tent [of] skins of rams dyed red, and a covering of skins of [tachash] from above.

en.L: And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of fine leather above [that].
en.B: Make a covering for the tent out of rams' skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
en.R: Make a covering for the tent from rams' skins dyed red. Over that, put a covering of fine leather.

es.L: Y harás una cubierta para la tienda de pieles de carneros teñidas de rojo, y una cubierta de cuero fino encima [de ella].
es.B: Harás para la tienda una cubierta de pieles de carnero teñidas de rojo, y encima, una cubierta de cuero fino.
es.R: Haz una cubierta para la tienda con pieles de carnero teñidas de rojo. Encima de ella, pon otra cubierta de cuero fino.

fr.L: Et tu feras une couverture pour la tente [en] peaux de béliers teintes en rouge, et une couverture de cuir fin par-dessus.
fr.B: Tu feras pour la tente une couverture en peaux de béliers teintes en rouge et, par-dessus, une couverture de cuir fin.
fr.R: Fais une couverture pour la tente avec des peaux de béliers teintes en rouge. Par-dessus, mets une autre couverture de cuir fin.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya kifuniko cha hema [kwa] ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na kifuniko cha ngozi bora juu [yake].
sw.B: Ufanye kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi bora.
sw.R: Tengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu. Juu yake weka kifuniko kingine cha ngozi bora.

decisions.choice: rams' skins dyed red: tanned leather colored red
decisions.reason: The skins of rams were tanned, and the tanning or a dye gave them a red color. They are among the gifts listed in 25:5.

decisions.choice: fine leather: skins of an animal or leather of a kind no longer known
decisions.reason: The word that names these skins is rare: it is found with the tabernacle (25:5; 35:7; Numbers 4:6-14) and for sandals in Ezekiel 16:10. It has been taken as the name of a sea animal, such as the dolphin or the dugong (sea cow), found in the Red Sea; as a kind of leather of special finish; or as a color. The meaning is not certain.

decisions.choice: from above: the outermost covering
decisions.reason: The phrase places this covering on top. Over the linen tabernacle lies the goats'-hair tent, then the rams' skins, then this covering of leather.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make the frames for the tabernacle [of] wood of acacia, standing.

en.L: And you shall make the frames for the tabernacle [of] acacia wood, standing [upright].
en.B: For the tabernacle make frames out of acacia wood, to stand upright.
en.R: Make frames of acacia wood. They will stand up straight and form the walls of the tabernacle.

es.L: Y harás los bastidores para el tabernáculo [de] madera de acacia, puestos de pie.
es.B: Para el tabernáculo harás bastidores de madera de acacia, que se mantendrán en pie.
es.R: Haz bastidores de madera de acacia. Estarán de pie, bien derechos, y formarán las paredes del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et tu feras les châssis pour la Demeure [en] bois d’acacia, debout.
fr.B: Pour la Demeure, tu feras des châssis en bois d’acacia, qui se tiendront debout.
fr.R: Fais des châssis en bois d’acacia. Ils seront dressés tout droits et formeront les murs du tabernacle.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya fremu za maskani [kwa] mbao za mshita, zikiwa zimesimama.
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya maskani ufanye fremu za mbao za mshita, zisimame wima.
sw.R: Tengeneza fremu kwa mbao za mshita. Zitasimama wima na kuwa kuta za maskani.

decisions.choice: frames: open upright frameworks, or perhaps solid boards
decisions.reason: The word is used of these pieces and once of the deck of a ship (Ezekiel 27:6). It has often been taken as solid boards or planks. But boards 10 cubits high and a cubit and a half wide (verse 16) would be very heavy to carry, each one has two "hands" (verse 17), and the cherubim of the linen curtains would be hidden behind a solid wall. So many take each piece as an open frame of two uprights joined by crosspieces. Either way, the pieces stand side by side to form the walls.

decisions.choice: acacia wood: a hard wood of the desert
decisions.reason: The acacia grows in the Sinai desert and the Jordan valley. Its wood is hard, light and lasting. The ark, the table, the altars and the poles were all made of it (25:10, 23; 27:1; 30:1).

decisions.choice: form the walls
decisions.reason: Readable says what the frames are for, which verses 18-25 make plain.

decisions.choice: "bastidores" (qerashim)
decisions.reason: The meaning note leaves open whether these were open frames or solid boards; "bastidores", like the English "frames", fits an open framework. "Marco" is kept for the rim of the table (25:25).

decisions.choice: "châssis" (qerashim)
decisions.reason: "Châssis", an upright framework, follows the English "frames"; "planches" would decide for solid boards, which the meaning note leaves open. "Cadre" is kept for the rim of the table (25:25).

decisions.choice: "fremu" (qerashim)
decisions.reason: "Fremu" is the everyday word for a frame; "mbao" (boards) would decide for solid planks, which the meaning note leaves open, and "kiunzi" is kept for the rim of the table (25:25).

source.text: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Ten cubits [will be] the length of the frame, and a cubit and the half of the cubit the width of the one frame.

en.L: Ten cubits [shall be] the length of the frame, and a cubit and a half the width of the one frame.
en.B: Make every frame {{units:about 15 feet|10 cubits}} high and {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|a cubit and a half}} wide.
en.R: Each frame must be {{units:about 15 feet|10 cubits}} tall and {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|a cubit and a half}} wide.

es.L: Diez codos [será] la longitud del bastidor, y un codo y medio la anchura de cada bastidor.
es.B: Cada bastidor tendrá {{units:unos 4,50 metros|diez codos}} de alto y {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de ancho.
es.R: Cada bastidor debe medir {{units:unos 4,50 metros|diez codos}} de alto y {{units:unos 70 centímetros|un codo y medio}} de ancho.

fr.L: Dix coudées [sera] la longueur du châssis, et une coudée et demie la largeur d’un châssis.
fr.B: Chaque châssis aura {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} de haut et {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de large.
fr.R: Chaque châssis doit mesurer {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} de haut et {{units:environ 70 centimètres|une coudée et demie}} de large.

sw.L: Dhiraa kumi [ndio] urefu wa fremu, na dhiraa moja na nusu upana wa fremu moja.
sw.B: Kila fremu iwe na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}} na upana wa {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}.
sw.R: Kimo cha kila fremu kiwe {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}, na upana wake {{units:karibu sentimita 70|dhiraa moja na nusu}}.

decisions.choice: length: the height of the standing frame
decisions.reason: Because the frames stand upright (verse 15), their length is their height. Twenty frames a cubit and a half wide make a wall 30 cubits long (verse 18).

decisions.choice: {{units:about 15 feet|10 cubits}} high; {{units:about 2 1/4 feet|a cubit and a half}} wide
decisions.reason: Measures as in verse 2, with a cubit as about 18 inches. Balanced and Readable say "high" or "tall" for the length of a standing frame.

source.text: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָד֗וֹת לַקֶּ֨רֶשׁ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Two hands [will be] for the one frame, joined, a woman to her sister; so you will do for all the frames of the tabernacle.

en.L: Two tenons [shall be] for the one frame, joined one to another; so you shall do for all the frames of the tabernacle.
en.B: Every frame will have two tenons, joined one to the other. Do this for every frame of the tabernacle.
en.R: Each frame must have two pegs at the bottom, joined to each other. Make every frame of the tabernacle the same way.

es.L: Dos espigas [tendrá] cada bastidor, unidas una con otra; así harás con todos los bastidores del tabernáculo.
es.B: Cada bastidor tendrá dos espigas, unidas la una a la otra. Así harás con todos los bastidores del tabernáculo.
es.R: Cada bastidor debe tener dos clavijas en la parte de abajo, unidas entre sí. Haz de la misma manera todos los bastidores del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Deux tenons [seront] à un châssis, joints l’un à l’autre ; ainsi tu feras pour tous les châssis de la Demeure.
fr.B: Chaque châssis aura deux tenons, reliés l’un à l’autre. Tu feras de même pour tous les châssis de la Demeure.
fr.R: Chaque châssis doit avoir deux chevilles en bas, reliées entre elles. Fais de la même façon tous les châssis du tabernacle.

sw.L: Ndimi mbili [zitakuwa] kwa fremu moja, zimeungwa moja na nyingine; ndivyo utakavyofanya kwa fremu zote za maskani.
sw.B: Kila fremu iwe na ndimi mbili, zimeungwa moja na nyingine. Ufanye hivyo kwa kila fremu ya maskani.
sw.R: Kila fremu lazima iwe na vigingi viwili chini, vimeungwa pamoja. Tengeneza fremu zote za maskani kwa namna hiyo.

decisions.choice: hands: tenons, pegs that fit into the bases
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "hands". They are the projecting ends of the frame that fit into the two silver bases beneath it (verse 19). They may be the lower ends of the two uprights of an open frame (see verse 15).

decisions.choice: joined to each other: the two tenons are linked together
alternatives: each frame joined to the next
decisions.reason: The word means joined or fitted, like the rungs of a ladder. It may mean the two uprights were joined by crosspieces, or that the tenons were set parallel. Some take it to mean that each frame was joined to the next.

decisions.choice: pegs at the bottom
decisions.reason: Readable says "pegs" for the tenons and adds where they are.

decisions.choice: "espigas" (L, B); "clavijas" (R)
decisions.reason: An "espiga" is the carpenter's tenon that fits into a socket; Readable says "clavijas" (pegs), as the English Readable says "pegs".

decisions.choice: "tenons" (L, B); "chevilles" (R)
decisions.reason: "Tenon" is the carpenter's word for a projecting end that fits into a socket; Readable says "chevilles" (pegs), as the English Readable says "pegs".

decisions.choice: "ndimi" (L, B); "vigingi" (R)
decisions.reason: "Ulimi" (pl. "ndimi") is used for the tongue of a wooden joint that fits into a socket; Readable says "vigingi" (pegs), as the English Readable says "pegs".

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קֶ֔רֶשׁ לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גְבָּה תֵימָֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the side of the Negev, southward.

en.L: And you shall make the frames for the tabernacle: twenty frames for the side toward the Negev, southward.
en.B: The south side of the tabernacle is to have twenty frames.
en.R: Make twenty frames for the south wall of the tabernacle.

es.L: Y harás los bastidores para el tabernáculo: veinte bastidores para el lado del Néguev, hacia el sur.
es.B: El lado sur del tabernáculo tendrá veinte bastidores.
es.R: Haz veinte bastidores para la pared del sur del tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et tu feras les châssis pour la Demeure : vingt châssis du côté du Néguev, vers le sud.
fr.B: Le côté sud de la Demeure aura vingt châssis.
fr.R: Fais vingt châssis pour le mur sud du tabernacle.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya fremu za maskani: fremu ishirini kwa upande wa Negebu, kusini.
sw.B: Upande wa kusini wa maskani uwe na fremu ishirini.
sw.R: Tengeneza fremu ishirini kwa ukuta wa upande wa kusini wa maskani.

decisions.choice: toward the Negev, southward: on the south side
decisions.reason: Two words for "south" stand together. The first is the Negev, the dry land to the south of Canaan; the second means the south. Together they stress the direction. The tabernacle faced east (27:13), so the south side was on the right.

source.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־כֶ֔סֶף תַּעֲשֶׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And forty bases of silver you will make under the twenty frames: two bases under the one frame for its two hands, and two bases under the one frame for its two hands.

en.L: And forty bases of silver you shall make under the twenty frames: two bases under the one frame for its two tenons, and two bases under the one frame for its two tenons.
en.B: Under the twenty frames set forty bases of silver, two beneath every frame to receive its two tenons.
en.R: Make forty silver bases to set under these twenty frames. Each frame stands in two bases, one for each peg.

es.L: Y cuarenta basas de plata harás debajo de los veinte bastidores: dos basas debajo de un bastidor para sus dos espigas, y dos basas debajo de un bastidor para sus dos espigas.
es.B: Debajo de los veinte bastidores pondrás cuarenta basas de plata, dos debajo de cada bastidor para recibir sus dos espigas.
es.R: Haz cuarenta basas de plata para ponerlas debajo de estos veinte bastidores. Cada bastidor se apoya en dos basas, una para cada clavija.

fr.L: Et tu feras quarante socles d’argent sous les vingt châssis : deux socles sous un châssis pour ses deux tenons, et deux socles sous un châssis pour ses deux tenons.
fr.B: Sous les vingt châssis, tu placeras quarante socles d’argent, deux sous chaque châssis pour recevoir ses deux tenons.
fr.R: Fais quarante socles en argent à placer sous ces vingt châssis. Chaque châssis repose sur deux socles, un pour chaque cheville.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya misingi arobaini ya fedha chini ya fremu ishirini: misingi miwili chini ya fremu moja kwa ndimi zake mbili, na misingi miwili chini ya fremu moja kwa ndimi zake mbili.
sw.B: Chini ya fremu ishirini uweke misingi arobaini ya fedha, miwili chini ya kila fremu kupokea ndimi zake mbili.
sw.R: Tengeneza misingi arobaini ya fedha ya kuweka chini ya fremu hizo ishirini. Kila fremu inasimama juu ya misingi miwili, mmoja kwa kila kigingi.

decisions.choice: bases: heavy sockets that hold the foot of each frame
decisions.reason: The word means a base or footing (Job 38:6). Each frame stands in two of them. According to 38:25-27 the silver for these bases came from the half shekel each man paid when the people were counted.

decisions.choice: two bases under the one frame, and two under the one frame: two under each frame
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the phrase to mean "under each frame in turn". The same pattern returns in verses 21 and 25.

decisions.choice: "basas" ('adanim)
decisions.reason: A "basa" is the block on which a post or pillar stands; it keeps these sockets apart from the base of the lampstand ("base", 25:31).

decisions.choice: "socles" ('adanim)
decisions.reason: A "socle" is the heavy block a post stands in; it keeps these sockets apart from the base of the lampstand ("base", 25:31).

decisions.choice: "misingi" ('adanim)
decisions.reason: "Msingi" is a footing or foundation, the block each frame stands in; "kitako" is kept for the base of the lampstand (25:31).

source.text: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And for the second side of the tabernacle, toward the side of the north, twenty frames,

en.L: And for the second side of the tabernacle, toward the north side, twenty frames,
en.B: For the other side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames
en.R: Make twenty frames for the north wall too.

es.L: Y para el segundo costado del tabernáculo, hacia el lado norte, veinte bastidores,
es.B: Para el otro costado del tabernáculo, el lado norte, harás veinte bastidores
es.R: Haz también veinte bastidores para la pared del norte.

fr.L: Et pour le second côté de la Demeure, vers le côté nord, vingt châssis,
fr.B: Pour l’autre côté de la Demeure, le côté nord, tu feras vingt châssis
fr.R: Fais aussi vingt châssis pour le mur nord.

sw.L: Na kwa upande wa pili wa maskani, kuelekea upande wa kaskazini, fremu ishirini,
sw.B: Kwa upande mwingine wa maskani, upande wa kaskazini, ufanye fremu ishirini
sw.R: Tengeneza pia fremu ishirini kwa ukuta wa kaskazini.

decisions.choice: side: one of the long sides of the structure
decisions.reason: The word means side, and it is also the word for the rib taken from the man (Genesis 2:21-22). Here it is a long side wall of the tabernacle, as in verses 26-27.

source.text: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: and their forty bases [of] silver: two bases under the one frame and two bases under the one frame.

en.L: and their forty bases [of] silver: two bases under the one frame and two bases under the one frame.
en.B: with their forty silver bases, two under each frame.
en.R: They also need forty silver bases, two under each frame.

es.L: y sus cuarenta basas [de] plata: dos basas debajo de un bastidor y dos basas debajo de un bastidor.
es.B: con sus cuarenta basas de plata, dos debajo de cada bastidor.
es.R: También hacen falta cuarenta basas de plata, dos debajo de cada bastidor.

fr.L: et leurs quarante socles [d’]argent : deux socles sous un châssis et deux socles sous un châssis.
fr.B: avec leurs quarante socles d’argent, deux sous chaque châssis.
fr.R: Il faut aussi quarante socles en argent, deux sous chaque châssis.

sw.L: na misingi yake arobaini [ya] fedha: misingi miwili chini ya fremu moja na misingi miwili chini ya fremu moja.
sw.B: pamoja na misingi yake arobaini ya fedha, miwili chini ya kila fremu.
sw.R: Pia zinahitaji misingi arobaini ya fedha, miwili chini ya kila fremu.

decisions.choice: two bases under each frame
decisions.reason: The repeated phrase means two under each frame, as in verse 19. The north side matches the south.

source.text: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And for the far parts of the tabernacle, seaward, you will make six frames.

en.L: And for the rear of the tabernacle, westward, you shall make six frames.
en.B: For the back of the tabernacle, the west end, make six frames.
en.R: Make six frames for the back wall, at the west end.

es.L: Y para la parte posterior del tabernáculo, hacia el occidente, harás seis bastidores.
es.B: Para el fondo del tabernáculo, el lado occidental, harás seis bastidores.
es.R: Haz seis bastidores para la pared del fondo, en el lado oeste.

fr.L: Et pour l’arrière de la Demeure, vers l’occident, tu feras six châssis.
fr.B: Pour le fond de la Demeure, du côté ouest, tu feras six châssis.
fr.R: Fais six châssis pour le mur du fond, du côté ouest.

sw.L: Na kwa upande wa nyuma wa maskani, kuelekea magharibi, utafanya fremu sita.
sw.B: Kwa upande wa nyuma wa maskani, mwisho wa magharibi, ufanye fremu sita.
sw.R: Tengeneza fremu sita kwa ukuta wa nyuma, upande wa magharibi.

decisions.choice: seaward: westward
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "toward the sea", that is, toward the Mediterranean, which lies west of Canaan. It is the usual way to say west.

decisions.choice: the far parts: the back of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The word means the remotest or innermost part. The entrance faced east (verse 36; 27:13), so the back was the west end, where the most holy place stood.

source.text: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And two frames you will make for the corners of the tabernacle in the far parts.

en.L: And two frames you shall make for the corners of the tabernacle at the rear.
en.B: Two more frames are for the back corners of the tabernacle.
en.R: Make two more frames for the back corners.

es.L: Y harás dos bastidores para las esquinas del tabernáculo, en la parte posterior.
es.B: Otros dos bastidores serán para las esquinas traseras del tabernáculo.
es.R: Haz otros dos bastidores para las esquinas de atrás.

fr.L: Et tu feras deux châssis pour les angles de la Demeure, à l’arrière.
fr.B: Deux autres châssis seront pour les angles arrière de la Demeure.
fr.R: Fais deux autres châssis pour les coins du fond.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya fremu mbili kwa pembe za maskani upande wa nyuma.
sw.B: Fremu nyingine mbili ziwe kwa pembe za nyuma za maskani.
sw.R: Tengeneza fremu nyingine mbili kwa pembe za nyuma.

decisions.choice: corners: the two back corners
decisions.reason: These two frames stand where the back wall meets the side walls. Their shape is not described, beyond what verse 24 says.

source.text: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִים֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַמִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be twins from below, and together they will be complete at its top, to the one ring; so it will be for both of them; for the two corners they will be.

en.L: And they shall be double from below, and together they shall be complete at its top, to the one ring; so it shall be for both of them; they shall be for the two corners.
en.B: They are to be double from the bottom and joined together at the top in a single ring. Both corner frames are to be made this way; they will form the two corners.
en.R: These corner frames must be double, joined together from bottom to top and held at the top by one ring. Make both corners this way.

es.L: Y serán dobles desde abajo, y juntos serán completos en su parte superior, hasta el único anillo; así será para ambos; para las dos esquinas serán.
es.B: Serán dobles desde abajo y estarán unidos arriba en un solo anillo. Así se harán los dos bastidores de las esquinas; ellos formarán las dos esquinas.
es.R: Estos bastidores de las esquinas deben ser dobles, unidos de abajo arriba y sujetos arriba por un solo anillo. Haz así las dos esquinas.

fr.L: Et ils seront doubles par le bas, et ensemble ils seront complets à leur sommet, jusqu’à l’anneau unique ; ainsi en sera-t-il pour tous les deux ; ils seront pour les deux angles.
fr.B: Ils seront doubles depuis le bas et réunis en haut par un seul anneau. Les deux châssis d’angle seront faits ainsi ; ils formeront les deux angles.
fr.R: Ces châssis d’angle doivent être doubles, assemblés du bas jusqu’en haut et tenus en haut par un seul anneau. Fais les deux coins de cette façon.

sw.L: Nazo zitakuwa mbili mbili kutoka chini, na pamoja zitakuwa kamili juu yake, hadi kwenye pete moja; ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa zote mbili; zitakuwa kwa ajili ya pembe mbili.
sw.B: Ziwe mbili mbili kutoka chini, na ziungwe pamoja juu kwa pete moja. Fremu zote mbili za pembeni zifanywe hivyo; zitakuwa pembe mbili.
sw.R: Fremu hizi za pembeni lazima ziwe mbili mbili, zimeungwa pamoja kutoka chini hadi juu na kushikwa juu kwa pete moja. Tengeneza pembe zote mbili kwa namna hiyo.

decisions.choice: twins ... complete: the corner frames are doubled and joined
alternatives: made double from bottom to top
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "twins" from below and "complete" or "whole" at the top. It seems each corner frame was paired with the next frame, or made double, and joined at the top by a ring, to make the corner strong. How this was done is not clear.

decisions.choice: the one ring: a single ring at the top
decisions.reason: A ring held the paired frames together at the top. It may be the ring for the top crossbar (verse 29).

source.text: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be eight frames, and their bases [of] silver, sixteen bases: two bases under the one frame and two bases under the one frame.

en.L: And there shall be eight frames, and their bases of silver, sixteen bases: two bases under the one frame and two bases under the one frame.
en.B: The back wall will then have eight frames standing on sixteen silver bases, a pair beneath every frame.
en.R: That makes eight frames for the back wall, with sixteen silver bases, two under each frame.

es.L: Y habrá ocho bastidores, y sus basas de plata, dieciséis basas: dos basas debajo de un bastidor y dos basas debajo de un bastidor.
es.B: La pared del fondo tendrá así ocho bastidores sobre dieciséis basas de plata, dos debajo de cada bastidor.
es.R: Así habrá ocho bastidores para la pared del fondo, con dieciséis basas de plata, dos debajo de cada bastidor.

fr.L: Et il y aura huit châssis, et leurs socles d’argent, seize socles : deux socles sous un châssis et deux socles sous un châssis.
fr.B: Le mur du fond aura ainsi huit châssis posés sur seize socles d’argent, deux sous chaque châssis.
fr.R: Cela fait huit châssis pour le mur du fond, avec seize socles en argent, deux sous chaque châssis.

sw.L: Nazo zitakuwa fremu nane, na misingi yake ya fedha, misingi kumi na sita: misingi miwili chini ya fremu moja na misingi miwili chini ya fremu moja.
sw.B: Hivyo ukuta wa nyuma utakuwa na fremu nane zilizosimama juu ya misingi kumi na sita ya fedha, miwili chini ya kila fremu.
sw.R: Hiyo ni fremu nane kwa ukuta wa nyuma, pamoja na misingi kumi na sita ya fedha, miwili chini ya kila fremu.

decisions.choice: eight frames: the six of the back wall and the two corner frames
decisions.reason: The six frames of verse 22 and the two of verse 23 make eight. With twenty on each side, there are forty-eight frames and ninety-six bases in all; with the four bases of the veil's pillars (verse 32), that makes the hundred silver bases of 38:27.

decisions.choice: The back wall
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say these frames make the back wall.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make bars [of] wood of acacia, five for the frames of the side of the tabernacle, the one,

en.L: And you shall make bars [of] acacia wood: five for the frames of the one side of the tabernacle,
en.B: You are also to make crossbars from acacia wood, five of them for the frames along one side of the tabernacle,
en.R: Make crossbars of acacia wood to hold the frames together. Make five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

es.L: Y harás travesaños [de] madera de acacia: cinco para los bastidores de un costado del tabernáculo,
es.B: Harás también travesaños de madera de acacia, cinco para los bastidores de uno de los costados del tabernáculo,
es.R: Haz travesaños de madera de acacia para mantener unidos los bastidores. Haz cinco para los bastidores de un costado del tabernáculo,

fr.L: Et tu feras des traverses [en] bois d’acacia : cinq pour les châssis d’un côté de la Demeure,
fr.B: Tu feras aussi des traverses en bois d’acacia, cinq pour les châssis de l’un des côtés de la Demeure,
fr.R: Fais des traverses en bois d’acacia pour tenir les châssis ensemble. Fais-en cinq pour les châssis d’un côté du tabernacle,

sw.L: Nawe utafanya mataruma [ya] mbao za mshita: matano kwa fremu za upande mmoja wa maskani,
sw.B: Ufanye pia mataruma ya mbao za mshita, matano kwa fremu za upande mmoja wa maskani,
sw.R: Tengeneza mataruma ya mbao za mshita ya kushikilia fremu pamoja. Tengeneza matano kwa fremu za upande mmoja wa maskani,

decisions.choice: bars: long poles laid across the frames
decisions.reason: The word means a bar or bolt (as on a city gate, Judges 16:3). These bars ran sideways through rings on the frames (verse 29) and held each wall in one line.

decisions.choice: crossbars
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "crossbars" to show that the bars run across the frames. Literal keeps "bars". Readable also adds what they are for.

decisions.choice: "travesaños" (beriḥim)
decisions.reason: "Travesaños" are bars laid across the frames, which is what the English "crossbars" says; "barras" is kept for the carrying poles of the ark, table and altar (25:13).

decisions.choice: "traverses" (beriḥim)
decisions.reason: "Traverses" are bars laid across the frames, as the English "crossbars" says; "barres" is kept for the carrying poles of the ark, table and altar (25:13).

decisions.choice: "mataruma" (beriḥim)
decisions.reason: "Taruma" is a crossbar; "mipiko" is kept for the carrying poles of the ark, table and altar (25:13).

source.text: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְקַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle, the second, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle, for the far parts, seaward.

en.L: and five bars for the frames of the second side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the frames of the side of the tabernacle at the rear, westward.
en.B: five for the frames of its other side, and five for the frames of the rear wall facing west.
en.R: five for the other side, and five for the back wall on the west.

es.L: y cinco travesaños para los bastidores del segundo costado del tabernáculo, y cinco travesaños para los bastidores del costado del tabernáculo, en la parte posterior, hacia el occidente.
es.B: cinco para los bastidores del otro costado, y cinco para los bastidores de la pared del fondo, que da al occidente.
es.R: cinco para el otro costado, y cinco para la pared del fondo, en el oeste.

fr.L: et cinq traverses pour les châssis du second côté de la Demeure, et cinq traverses pour les châssis du côté de la Demeure, à l’arrière, vers l’occident.
fr.B: cinq pour les châssis de l’autre côté, et cinq pour les châssis du mur du fond, tourné vers l’ouest.
fr.R: cinq pour l’autre côté, et cinq pour le mur du fond, à l’ouest.

sw.L: na mataruma matano kwa fremu za upande wa pili wa maskani, na mataruma matano kwa fremu za upande wa maskani ulio nyuma, kuelekea magharibi.
sw.B: matano kwa fremu za upande mwingine, na matano kwa fremu za ukuta wa nyuma unaoelekea magharibi.
sw.R: matano kwa upande mwingine, na matano kwa ukuta wa nyuma upande wa magharibi.

decisions.choice: five bars on each of the three walls: fifteen in all
decisions.reason: Each of the three walls had five bars; the east end was the entrance, with its own screen and pillars (verses 36-37). Verse 28 describes the middle bar of each wall.

source.text: וְהַבְּרִ֥יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֖ן בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן־הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־הַקָּצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the middle bar in the midst of the frames [will be] passing through from the end to the end.

en.L: And the middle bar, in the midst of the frames, shall pass through from end to end.
en.B: The middle crossbar, set halfway up the frames, is to reach all the way from one end to the other.
en.R: The middle crossbar must go halfway up the frames and reach from one end of the wall to the other.

es.L: Y el travesaño del medio, en medio de los bastidores, pasará de un extremo al otro.
es.B: El travesaño del medio, colocado a media altura de los bastidores, irá de un extremo al otro.
es.R: El travesaño del medio debe ir a media altura de los bastidores y llegar de un extremo de la pared al otro.

fr.L: Et la traverse du milieu, au milieu des châssis, passera d’une extrémité à l’autre.
fr.B: La traverse du milieu, placée à mi-hauteur des châssis, ira d’un bout à l’autre.
fr.R: La traverse du milieu doit passer à mi-hauteur des châssis et aller d’un bout du mur à l’autre.

sw.L: Na taruma la katikati, katikati ya fremu, litapita kutoka mwisho hadi mwisho.
sw.B: Taruma la katikati, lililowekwa nusu ya kimo cha fremu, lifike kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine.
sw.R: Taruma la katikati lazima lipite nusu ya kimo cha fremu, kutoka mwisho mmoja wa ukuta hadi mwingine.

decisions.choice: the middle bar passes from end to end: one bar running the whole length of the wall
decisions.reason: The middle bar reaches the full length of each wall; the other four are perhaps shorter, two above and two below it. "In the midst of the frames" may mean halfway up, or that the bar ran through the frames themselves; the word "pass through" is used of it again in 36:33.

source.text: וְֽאֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת־הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And the frames you will overlay [with] gold, and their rings you will make [of] gold, houses for the bars, and you will overlay the bars [with] gold.

en.L: And the frames you shall overlay [with] gold, and their rings you shall make [of] gold, holders for the bars; and you shall overlay the bars [with] gold.
en.B: Overlay the frames with gold, and make their rings of gold as holders for the crossbars; the crossbars too you are to overlay with gold.
en.R: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold. Then make gold rings on the frames. The crossbars will slide through these rings.

es.L: Y los bastidores los revestirás [de] oro, y sus anillos los harás [de] oro, alojamiento para los travesaños; y revestirás los travesaños [de] oro.
es.B: Revestirás de oro los bastidores, y harás de oro sus anillos, como alojamiento para los travesaños; también los travesaños los revestirás de oro.
es.R: Cubre de oro los bastidores y los travesaños. Luego pon anillos de oro en los bastidores. Los travesaños pasarán por esos anillos.

fr.L: Et les châssis, tu [les] plaqueras [d’]or, et leurs anneaux, tu [les] feras [en] or, logements pour les traverses ; et tu plaqueras les traverses [d’]or.
fr.B: Tu plaqueras d’or les châssis, et tu feras en or leurs anneaux, qui serviront de logements aux traverses ; les traverses aussi, tu les plaqueras d’or.
fr.R: Recouvre d’or les châssis et les traverses. Puis fixe des anneaux d’or sur les châssis. Les traverses glisseront dans ces anneaux.

sw.L: Na fremu utazifunika [kwa] dhahabu, na pete zake utazifanya [kwa] dhahabu, vishikio vya mataruma; nawe utayafunika mataruma [kwa] dhahabu.
sw.B: Uzifunike fremu kwa dhahabu, na pete zake uzifanye za dhahabu, ziwe vishikio vya mataruma; mataruma nayo uyafunike kwa dhahabu.
sw.R: Funika fremu na mataruma kwa dhahabu. Kisha weka pete za dhahabu kwenye fremu. Mataruma yatapita ndani ya pete hizo.

decisions.choice: houses for the bars: holders for the bars
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls the rings "houses" for the bars: they are where the bars rest. The same phrase is used of the rings for the poles of the ark and table (25:27).

decisions.choice: overlay: cover with a layer of gold
decisions.reason: The verb means to cover or plate. The wood was covered with thin sheets of gold, as the ark was (25:11).

source.text: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּמִ֨שְׁפָּט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּהָֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will set up the tabernacle according to its plan which you have been shown on the mountain.

en.L: And you shall set up the tabernacle according to its plan that you were shown on the mountain.
en.B: Erect the tabernacle following the design that was shown to you on the mountain.
en.R: Set up the tabernacle just as I showed you on the mountain.

es.L: Y levantarás el tabernáculo conforme a su ordenación, que te fue mostrada en el monte.
es.B: Erigirás el tabernáculo según el diseño que se te mostró en el monte.
es.R: Arma el tabernáculo tal como te lo mostré en el monte.

fr.L: Et tu dresseras la Demeure selon son ordonnance qui t’a été montrée sur la montagne.
fr.B: Tu dresseras la Demeure d’après le plan qui t’a été montré sur la montagne.
fr.R: Monte le tabernacle exactement comme je te l’ai montré sur la montagne.

sw.L: Nawe utaisimamisha maskani kulingana na utaratibu wake ulioonyeshwa mlimani.
sw.B: Uisimamishe maskani kwa kufuata mpango ulioonyeshwa mlimani.
sw.R: Isimamishe maskani sawasawa na nilivyokuonyesha mlimani.

decisions.choice: its plan: the right arrangement laid down for it
decisions.reason: The word usually means a judgment or a rule; here it is the proper order or design of the tabernacle. Elsewhere the word for "pattern" is used (25:9, 40).

decisions.choice: shown on the mountain: God showed Moses the design on Sinai
decisions.reason: As in 25:9, 40 and 27:8, the tabernacle is built after what God showed Moses on the mountain. Hebrews 8:5 quotes 25:40 and calls the earthly sanctuary a copy and shadow of the heavenly one.

decisions.choice: I showed you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "you were shown". God is speaking, and he is the one who showed Moses, so Readable says "I showed you".

decisions.choice: "son ordonnance"
decisions.reason: The word here is not the "pattern" of 25:9, 40 ("modèle") but the word for a rule or right order; Literal says "ordonnance", the proper arrangement, and Balanced "plan".

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make a veil [of] blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen; the work of a skillful worker one will make it, [with] cherubim.

en.L: And you shall make a veil of blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen; the work of a skilled craftsman, one shall make it [with] cherubim.
en.B: Make the inner curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen. It is to be the work of a skilled craftsman, with cherubim worked into its design.
en.R: Make an inner curtain from blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen. Have a skilled craftsman work cherubim into it.

es.L: Y harás un velo de [hilo] azul, y púrpura, y escarlata, y lino fino torcido; obra de un artesano hábil, se hará [con] querubines.
es.B: Harás la cortina interior de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata y de lino fino torcido. Será obra de un artesano hábil, con querubines tejidos en su diseño.
es.R: Haz una cortina interior con hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata y lino fino torcido. Pide a un artesano hábil que teja querubines en ella.

fr.L: Et tu feras un voile [de fil] bleu, et pourpre, et écarlate, et de fin lin retors ; travail d’un artisan habile, on le fera [avec] des chérubins.
fr.B: Tu feras le rideau intérieur de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate et de fin lin retors. Ce sera l’œuvre d’un artisan habile, avec des chérubins tissés dans son motif.
fr.R: Fais un rideau intérieur avec du fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate et du fin lin retors. Demande à un artisan habile d’y tisser des chérubins.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya pazia la [uzi wa] samawati, na zambarau, na rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa; kazi ya fundi stadi, litafanywa [pamoja na] makerubi.
sw.B: Ufanye pazia la ndani kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa. Liwe kazi ya fundi stadi, lenye makerubi yaliyofumwa katika mchoro wake.
sw.R: Tengeneza pazia la ndani kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa. Mwambie fundi stadi afume makerubi ndani yake.

decisions.choice: veil: the dividing curtain before the most holy place
decisions.reason: This word is used only of the curtain that shut off the most holy place (verse 33; Leviticus 16:2). In the temple, the veil was torn in two at the death of Jesus (Matthew 27:51; Hebrews 10:20).

decisions.choice: the work of a skillful worker, with cherubim: like the linen curtains
decisions.reason: The veil is made of the same materials and with the same woven cherubim as the inner curtains of the tabernacle (verse 1). Cherubim guarded the way to the tree of life (Genesis 3:24), and two cherubim stood over the ark (25:18-22).

decisions.choice: inner curtain / curtain
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "veil", the traditional name for this hanging. Balanced and Readable say "curtain", and "inner curtain" the first time, to set it apart from the curtains of verses 1-13.

decisions.choice: "pazia" (L); "pazia la ndani" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Swahili has no separate traditional word for the veil, so Literal says "pazia", and Balanced and Readable "pazia la ndani" (inner curtain), as the English does; the qualifier keeps it apart from the "mapazia" of verses 1-13.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ עַל־אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־כָֽסֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put it on four pillars of acacia overlaid [with] gold, their hooks [of] gold, on four bases of silver.

en.L: And you shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid [with] gold, their hooks [of] gold, on four bases of silver.
en.B: Hang it from four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold. Their hooks are to be of gold, and they will stand on four bases of silver.
en.R: Hang it on four acacia-wood posts covered with gold. Give the posts gold hooks and set them in four silver bases.

es.L: Y lo colgarás de cuatro columnas de acacia revestidas [de] oro, sus ganchos [de] oro, sobre cuatro basas de plata.
es.B: La colgarás de cuatro columnas de acacia revestidas de oro. Sus ganchos serán de oro, y estarán sobre cuatro basas de plata.
es.R: Cuélgala de cuatro postes de madera de acacia cubiertos de oro. Ponles a los postes ganchos de oro y colócalos sobre cuatro basas de plata.

fr.L: Et tu le suspendras à quatre colonnes d’acacia plaquées [d’]or, leurs crochets [d’]or, sur quatre socles d’argent.
fr.B: Tu le suspendras à quatre colonnes d’acacia plaquées d’or. Leurs crochets seront en or, et elles reposeront sur quatre socles d’argent.
fr.R: Suspends-le à quatre poteaux en bois d’acacia recouverts d’or. Mets des crochets d’or aux poteaux et dresse-les sur quatre socles en argent.

sw.L: Nawe utalitundika juu ya nguzo nne za mshita zilizofunikwa [kwa] dhahabu, kulabu zake [za] dhahabu, juu ya misingi minne ya fedha.
sw.B: Ulitundike kwenye nguzo nne za mshita zilizofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Kulabu zake ziwe za dhahabu, nazo zisimame juu ya misingi minne ya fedha.
sw.R: Litundike kwenye nguzo nne za mbao za mshita zilizofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Zipe nguzo hizo kulabu za dhahabu, na uzisimamishe kwenye misingi minne ya fedha.

decisions.choice: hooks: pegs or hooks on the pillars
decisions.reason: The word is used only of the hooks or pegs on the tabernacle's pillars (here, verse 37; 27:10). The veil hung from them.

decisions.choice: posts
decisions.reason: Readable says "posts" for the pillars, since they are wooden poles, not stone columns.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת־הַפָּרֹכֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַקְּרָסִים֒ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֨מָּה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְהִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַפָּרֹ֨כֶת֙ לָכֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּבֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the veil under the clasps, and you will bring there, inside the veil, the ark of the testimony; and the veil will separate for you between the holy [place] and the holy of holies.

en.L: And you shall put the veil under the clasps, and you shall bring there, inside the veil, the ark of the testimony; and the veil shall separate for you between the holy [place] and the holy of holies.
en.B: Put the curtain in place beneath the clasps, and bring the ark of the testimony there, inside the curtain. For you it will mark the division between the holy place and the most holy place.
en.R: Hang the inner curtain below the clasps. Then bring the ark that holds the covenant tablets in behind it. This curtain will divide the holy place from the most holy place.

es.L: Y pondrás el velo debajo de los broches, y meterás allí, dentro del velo, el arca del Testimonio; y el velo {{plural_you:les|os}} separará el [lugar] santo del santo de los santos.
es.B: Pondrás la cortina debajo de los broches, y meterás allí, detrás de la cortina, el arca del Testimonio. Esa cortina {{plural_you:les|os}} servirá de separación entre el lugar santo y el lugar santísimo.
es.R: Cuelga la cortina interior debajo de los broches. Luego mete detrás de ella el arca donde están las tablas del pacto. Esa cortina separará el lugar santo del lugar santísimo.

fr.L: Et tu mettras le voile sous les agrafes, et tu apporteras là, à l’intérieur du voile, l’arche du Témoignage ; et le voile fera pour vous la séparation entre le [lieu] saint et le saint des saints.
fr.B: Tu placeras le rideau sous les agrafes, et tu apporteras là, derrière le rideau, l’arche du Témoignage. Pour vous, ce rideau marquera la séparation entre le lieu saint et le lieu très saint.
fr.R: Suspends le rideau intérieur sous les agrafes. Ensuite, place derrière lui l’arche qui contient les tablettes de l’alliance. Ce rideau séparera le lieu saint du lieu très saint.
