sw.L: Nawe utaliweka pazia chini ya vifungo, na kuleta huko, ndani ya pazia, sanduku la Ushuhuda; na pazia hilo litawatengea kati ya [mahali] patakatifu na Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
sw.B: Uliweke pazia chini ya vifungo, na ulilete sanduku la Ushuhuda huko, nyuma ya pazia. Pazia hilo litawatenganishia mahali patakatifu na Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
sw.R: Litundike pazia la ndani chini ya vifungo. Kisha lilete sanduku lenye vibao vya agano nyuma yake. Pazia hilo litatenganisha mahali patakatifu na Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.

decisions.choice: under the clasps: below the line where the two sets of linen curtains meet
decisions.reason: The gold clasps of verse 6 joined the two sets of five linen curtains, 20 cubits from the front. Hanging the veil below them would make the most holy place a cube of 10 cubits each way. The verse does not give this measure; it follows from the earlier ones.

decisions.choice: the testimony: the tablets of the covenant
decisions.reason: "The testimony" is the two stone tablets that God gave and told Moses to put in the ark (25:16, 21; 31:18), so the ark is named after them.

decisions.choice: the holy of holies: the most holy place
decisions.reason: "Holy of holies" is the Hebrew way of saying "most holy", as "king of kings" means the greatest king. The inner room was holier than the outer one, called simply "the holy place".

decisions.choice: the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable calls the ark of the testimony "the ark that holds the covenant tablets", since "the testimony" is the tablets of the covenant kept inside it.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:les|os}} separará
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "for you" here is plural: the veil divides the two rooms for Israel and its priests, not for Moses alone, so Spanish uses the plural with the usual ustedes/vosotros setting.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the atonement cover on the ark of the testimony in the holy of holies.

en.L: And you shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the holy of holies.
en.B: Place the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
en.R: In the most holy place, put the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered, on the ark that holds the covenant tablets.

es.L: Y pondrás el propiciatorio sobre el arca del Testimonio en el santo de los santos.
es.B: Colocarás el propiciatorio sobre el arca del Testimonio, en el lugar santísimo.
es.R: En el lugar santísimo, pon la tapa del arca, el lugar donde se cubren los pecados, sobre el arca donde están las tablas del pacto.

fr.L: Et tu mettras le propitiatoire sur l’arche du Témoignage dans le saint des saints.
fr.B: Tu placeras le propitiatoire sur l’arche du Témoignage, dans le lieu très saint.
fr.R: Dans le lieu très saint, mets le couvercle de l’arche, l’endroit où les péchés sont couverts, sur l’arche qui contient les tablettes de l’alliance.

sw.L: Nawe utakiweka kiti cha rehema juu ya sanduku la Ushuhuda katika Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
sw.B: Ukiweke kiti cha rehema juu ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
sw.R: Ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, weka kifuniko cha sanduku, mahali ambapo dhambi zinafunikwa, juu ya sanduku lenye vibao vya agano.

decisions.choice: mercy seat: the lid of the ark, the place of atonement
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb for making atonement, covering sin. It is the gold lid of the ark (25:17-22), where the blood was sprinkled on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:14-15). See the note at 25:17.

decisions.choice: the lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered
decisions.reason: Readable explains the mercy seat by what it is and what it was for, as at 25:17. Literal and Balanced keep "mercy seat".

source.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהַ֨שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle southward, and the table you will put on the north side.

en.L: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table, on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and the table you shall put on the north side.
en.B: Set the table outside the curtain, and the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle. The table you are to put on the north side.
en.R: Put the table and the lampstand outside the inner curtain. Put the lampstand on the south side, across from the table. Put the table on the north side.

es.L: Y pondrás la mesa fuera del velo, y el candelabro enfrente de la mesa, en el costado del tabernáculo hacia el sur; y la mesa la pondrás en el costado norte.
es.B: Pondrás la mesa fuera de la cortina, y el candelabro enfrente de la mesa, en el lado sur del tabernáculo. La mesa la pondrás en el lado norte.
es.R: Pon la mesa y el candelabro fuera de la cortina interior. Pon el candelabro en el lado sur, frente a la mesa. Pon la mesa en el lado norte.

fr.L: Et tu placeras la table à l’extérieur du voile, et le chandelier en face de la table, sur le côté de la Demeure vers le sud ; et la table, tu la mettras sur le côté nord.
fr.B: Tu placeras la table à l’extérieur du rideau, et le chandelier en face de la table, du côté sud de la Demeure. La table, tu la mettras du côté nord.
fr.R: Place la table et le chandelier devant le rideau intérieur, à l’extérieur. Mets le chandelier du côté sud, en face de la table. Mets la table du côté nord.

sw.L: Nawe utaiweka meza nje ya pazia, na kinara cha taa kuelekeana na meza, upande wa maskani wa kusini; na meza utaiweka upande wa kaskazini.
sw.B: Uiweke meza nje ya pazia, na kinara cha taa kuelekeana na meza upande wa kusini wa maskani. Meza uiweke upande wa kaskazini.
sw.R: Weka meza na kinara cha taa nje ya pazia la ndani. Weka kinara cha taa upande wa kusini, mkabala na meza. Weka meza upande wa kaskazini.

decisions.choice: the table and the lampstand: the furnishings of the holy place
decisions.reason: The table for the bread of the Presence (25:23-30) and the lampstand (25:31-40) stand in the outer room, outside the veil. The altar of incense is added in 30:1-6, in front of the veil.

decisions.choice: southward ... north: the lampstand on the left of the one entering, the table on the right
decisions.reason: Coming in from the east, the lampstand stood on the south side, on the left, and the table on the north side, on the right.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make a screen for the entrance of the tent [of] blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen, the work of a worker in colors.

en.L: And you shall make a screen for the entrance of the tent [of] blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer.
en.B: Make a screen for the doorway of the tent from blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, worked in colors by an embroiderer.
en.R: Make a screen for the entrance of the tent. Make it from blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, and have an embroiderer decorate it.

es.L: Y harás una cortina para la entrada de la tienda, [de hilo] azul, y púrpura, y escarlata, y lino fino torcido, obra de bordador.
es.B: Harás para la puerta de la tienda una cortina de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata y de lino fino torcido, trabajada en colores por un bordador.
es.R: Haz una cortina para la entrada de la tienda. Hazla con hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata y lino fino torcido, y pide a un bordador que la adorne.

fr.L: Et tu feras un rideau pour l’entrée de la tente, [de fil] bleu, et pourpre, et écarlate, et de fin lin retors, ouvrage de brodeur.
fr.B: Tu feras pour l’entrée de la tente un rideau de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate et de fin lin retors, travaillé en couleurs par un brodeur.
fr.R: Fais un rideau pour l’entrée de la tente. Fais-le avec du fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate et du fin lin retors, et demande à un brodeur de le décorer.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya pazia la mlango wa hema, [la uzi wa] samawati, na zambarau, na rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kazi ya mtarizi.
sw.B: Ufanye pazia la mlango wa hema kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, lililotariziwa kwa rangi na mtarizi.
sw.R: Tengeneza pazia la mlango wa hema. Litengeneze kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kisha mwambie mtarizi alipambe.

decisions.choice: screen: a hanging that covers the entrance
decisions.reason: The word means a covering or screen. It closes the east entrance of the tent and is different from the veil inside (verse 31). The courtyard gate has a screen of its own (27:16).

decisions.choice: the work of a worker in colors: embroidered or woven in colored patterns
alternatives: the work of a weaver of colors
decisions.reason: The worker named here works in many colors, by needle or on the loom. This is a different craft from the "skillful worker" whose cloth bears cherubim (verses 1 and 31); no cherubim are named on the screen.

decisions.choice: "una cortina para la entrada" (masakh); "bordador"
decisions.reason: Spanish has no usual word for an entrance screen of cloth; "cortina para la entrada" names it by its place, apart from the inner "cortina interior" of verse 31. The "roqem" is a worker in colored thread, "bordador".

decisions.choice: "un rideau" (masakh); "brodeur"
decisions.reason: "Rideau" is the plain word for a hanging that closes a doorway; the veil is "voile" (L) or "rideau intérieur" (B, R). The "roqem" works in colored thread, "brodeur".

decisions.choice: "pazia la mlango" (masakh); "mtarizi"
decisions.reason: "Pazia la mlango" is the ordinary name for a hanging over a doorway, apart from the "pazia la ndani" of verse 31. The worker in colored thread is "mtarizi" (embroiderer).

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לַמָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will make for the screen five pillars of acacia and overlay them [with] gold, their hooks [of] gold, and you will cast for them five bases of bronze.

en.L: And you shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia and overlay them [with] gold, their hooks [of] gold; and you shall cast for them five bases of bronze.
en.B: Make five pillars of acacia wood for the screen and overlay them with gold; their hooks are to be gold. Cast five bases of bronze for them as well.
en.R: Make five acacia-wood posts for the screen. Cover them with gold and give them gold hooks. Then pour melted bronze into molds to make five bases for them.

es.L: Y harás para la cortina cinco columnas de acacia, y las revestirás [de] oro, sus ganchos [de] oro; y fundirás para ellas cinco basas de bronce.
es.B: Harás para la cortina cinco columnas de madera de acacia y las revestirás de oro; sus ganchos serán de oro. Fundirás también para ellas cinco basas de bronce.
es.R: Haz cinco postes de madera de acacia para la cortina. Cúbrelos de oro y ponles ganchos de oro. Luego echa bronce derretido en moldes para hacer cinco basas para esos postes.

fr.L: Et tu feras pour le rideau cinq colonnes d’acacia, et tu les plaqueras [d’]or, leurs crochets [d’]or ; et tu fondras pour elles cinq socles de bronze.
fr.B: Tu feras pour le rideau cinq colonnes en bois d’acacia, que tu plaqueras d’or ; leurs crochets seront en or. Tu fondras aussi pour elles cinq socles de bronze.
fr.R: Fais cinq poteaux en bois d’acacia pour le rideau. Recouvre-les d’or et mets-y des crochets d’or. Ensuite, verse du bronze fondu dans des moules pour faire cinq socles pour ces poteaux.

sw.L: Nawe utafanya kwa ajili ya pazia nguzo tano za mshita, na kuzifunika [kwa] dhahabu, kulabu zake [za] dhahabu; nawe utazisubia misingi mitano ya shaba.
sw.B: Ufanye kwa ajili ya pazia hilo nguzo tano za mbao za mshita, uzifunike kwa dhahabu; kulabu zake ziwe za dhahabu. Uzisubie pia misingi mitano ya shaba.
sw.R: Tengeneza nguzo tano za mbao za mshita kwa ajili ya pazia hilo. Zifunike kwa dhahabu na uziwekee kulabu za dhahabu. Kisha mimina shaba iliyoyeyushwa katika vyombo vya kusubu ili kutengeneza misingi mitano ya nguzo hizo.

decisions.choice: bases of bronze: a less costly metal at the entrance
decisions.reason: Inside, the frames and the pillars of the veil stand on silver (verses 19 and 32); the pillars of the entrance stand on bronze, as do those of the courtyard (27:10). The metals are less precious the farther they are from the most holy place.

decisions.choice: pour melted bronze into molds
decisions.reason: Readable explains "cast". It says "posts" for the pillars, as in verse 32.
